Hi Everyone! My name is Taryn R. I’ve been a pediatric physical therapist for over 15 years. I have been working with children who need assistance in gaining strength, improving their overall balance, working on their body movements and bilateral coordination. I also work on their motor planning, reaction times, body awareness and safety awareness. I’m certifiied as a pediatric massage therapist and a certified kinesiotaping practitioner.  I incorporate different movements of yoga 🧘🏻‍♂️ to increase flexibility, strength and motor planning.  I add agility drills and body coordination movements as well. 
Each child is different. Each one has strength and the gift to reach their best self.
